title: DexBioLab: Benchmarking Dexterous Manipulation with Dynamic Experimental Phenomena in Realistic Laboratories
authors: Xuanye Wu, Yue Shi, Yongcan Yang, Yiqun Wang, Zhaoqi Wan, Dayu Xia, Yanming Shao, Jiezhang Cao, Xiangfei Li, Yao Mu, Guangtao Zhai

hands.zh: 3 种灵巧手：Shadow、Wuji、XHand，另含 Aloha 夹爪平台；“4 种本体”不等于 4 种灵巧手，含单／双臂配置。真机验证为 UR5e＋XHand。
hands.en: Three dexterous hands: Shadow, Wuji and XHand, plus an Aloha gripper platform; four embodiments do not mean four dexterous hands. Includes single/bimanual setups; hardware validation uses UR5e + XHand.

tasks.zh: 14 个任务条目，含 Shadow／XHand 两种试管转移配置，覆盖工具使用、精细操作、语言视觉定位和仪器操作；如移液、镊子操作、旋拧试管盖、装吸头、操作本生灯及热循环仪。主模型评测选其中 12 项，每任务 3 个种子×100 回合。
tasks.en: 14 entries, including Shadow/XHand tube-transfer variants, spanning tool use, precision, language grounding and instrument operation, e.g. pipetting, tweezers, caps, tips, burners and thermal cyclers. Main policy evaluation covers 12 tasks with 3 seeds × 100 rollouts each.

cross_hand.zh: 任务按指定本体配置；试管转移明确提供 Shadow 与 XHand 版本，未验证全部 14 项对任意手直接复用，也未报告同一策略权重跨手泛化。
cross_hand.en: Tasks use assigned embodiments; tube transfer explicitly has Shadow and XHand variants. Direct reuse of all tasks with arbitrary hands and shared-weight cross-hand transfer are not established.

release.zh: 官方仿真代码公开，README 提供场景下载脚本、PFSM 示范采集、LeRobot 数据渲染及 OpenPI 评测流程；场景资产未下载核验。项目页预生成数据集仍为 Coming soon；截至核验日未找到任务策略 checkpoint 的官方下载入口，评测示例要求自行提供训练权重。
release.en: Simulation code is public with scene-download, PFSM collection, LeRobot rendering and OpenPI evaluation instructions; scene downloads were not tested. The project marks the dataset Coming soon. No official task-policy checkpoint download was found; examples require user-supplied trained weights.

highlight.zh: 将六个真实实验室的 3DGS 背景、可交互仿真前景与可控火焰／蒸汽／气泡结合，检验动态视觉下的精细操作；基于 mjlab 的并行采集与解耦回放渲染支持闭环评测。粒子现象与物理解耦，不是高精度流体、燃烧或化学反应仿真。
highlight.en: Combines six real-lab 3DGS backgrounds, interactive foregrounds and controllable flame/vapor/bubble visuals for fine manipulation; mjlab parallel collection and decoupled replay rendering support closed-loop evaluation. Particles are visual effects decoupled from physics, not high-fidelity fluid, combustion or chemistry simulation.

evaluation_scope.zh: 按用户指定 v3 记录，已有 v4。仿真比较 DP、π₀.₅、GR00T-N1.7、Fast-WAM，均经任务数据微调。真机试管转移每条件 20 次，3DGS／普通背景的归一化进度分为 66%／17%，不是任务成功率。v3 正文称使用 10 条真机＋90 条仿真示范，附录另写 100 条真机示范，数据配比有不一致，待作者澄清；不能表述为纯仿真零样本迁移。资源仅核查公开页面，未本地运行。
evaluation_scope.en: Records requested v3; v4 exists. Simulation compares task-fine-tuned DP, π₀.₅, GR00T-N1.7 and Fast-WAM. Real tube-transfer validation uses 20 trials per condition: 3DGS/standard-background normalized progress is 66%/17%, not success rate. The v3 main text states 10 real + 90 simulated demonstrations, but the appendix states 100 real demonstrations; this discrepancy needs clarification. This is not established simulation-only zero-shot transfer. Public resources were inspected, not run locally.
